g.text: sd — UC10/UC11 Invite a member and join from the invitation
in one write: invitation {email, hash(token), expires +7 d}
sign in or sign up (email pre-filled)
202 "verify your email to join" (UC2), no membership
After UC2, the user is offered the invitations
to that email still PENDING and not expired;
in one write: membership + invitation ACCEPTED
